# app-private: only if BoatAttack is installed (seal installs it once). signal-box target may not exist -> create.
[ "$(sha "$LIBD/$f")" = "$want" ] || fail "BOAT_PRIVATE_VERIFY $f"; log "boat private $f -> $want"
log "BoatAttack not installed ($LIBD absent) — shared overlay applied; private binds skipped (install APK first)"
CFG_SRC=00_westlake_u13_recover-boatv2.cfg; CFG_DST_NAME=00_westlake_u13_recover.cfg
BOAT_SRCS="liboh_adapter_bridge.so:8ab85446f8b386c4a649576326d5f393669b3a22529874fb673eea7c3b1cd71e \
[ -f "$INIT_CFG_DIR/$CFG_DST_NAME" ] || fail "NO_CCWIKI_RECOVER_CFG $INIT_CFG_DIR/$CFG_DST_NAME (ownership-(a) replaces cc-wiki's recover cfg in place; it must exist)"
for pr in $BOAT_SRCS; do
for pair in "scripts/$OVERLAY:$SCRIPT_DIR/$OVERLAY" "scripts/$DISABLE:$SCRIPT_DIR/$DISABLE" "init/$CFG_SRC:$INIT_CFG_DIR/$CFG_DST_NAME"; do
umount "$t" 2>/dev/null && log "umounted $t"
# 2. remove init cfg + scripts (restore backups if present) — sealed /system
if [ -f "$BACKUP/$(basename "$dst").bak" ]; then cp "$BACKUP/$(basename "$dst").bak" "$dst" && log "restored $dst"; else rm -f "$dst" 2>/dev/null && log "removed $dst"; fi
